notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Void Maw.
Cast Eternal Scourge from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
